title: kith-peer: DeliverHandler N-participant chatId + group participants field
description:
What: Generalize DeliverHandler chatId recomputation from 2 participants to N, and add participants field to PeerDeliverArgs for group messages.

Algorithm:
1. Add optional participants: Option<Vec<String>> to InboundMessage struct.
2. In DeliverHandler::call(), after extracting identity:
   a. Build participant list: if msg.participants is Some and non-empty, use it; else use [sender_id, owner_id] (direct chat default).
   b. Always include owner_id in participant list (add if missing).
   c. Sort participants lexicographically.
   d. Recompute expected_chat_id = compute_chat_id(&sorted_participants).
   e. Compare to msg.chat_id: if mismatch, return invalidArguments (same as before).
3. For group messages: when creating/updating chat, pass kind="group" and full sorted participant list to store.chats().get_or_create().
4. For direct messages: existing behavior (kind="direct", 2 participants).
5. In outbox_tick / build_peer_deliver_request: when message is in a group chat, include participants field in outbound JMAP request (pass chat.participants to build_peer_deliver_request).

Defensive rules: always recompute chatId, never trust peer-supplied value; always include owner_id in participants; sort before hashing; validate each participant id non-empty; max 50 participants.

Agent team: R reads DeliverHandler chatId check (line 133) and compute_chat_id; I implements; T writes tests: direct deliver still works; group deliver with 3 participants computes correct chatId; wrong participants rejected; participants list missing treated as direct (2-person); V runs cargo test -p kith-peer + clippy.
